mapper.select: select max(c.last_seen_at) from monitor_lark_chat c where 1 = 1
mapper.insert:
insert into monitor_lark_chat (site_code, chat_id, name, status, last_seen_at, update_time) values
(#{scope.siteCode}, #{ch.chatId}, #{ch.name}, 'ok', #{now}, #{now})
on conflict (site_code, chat_id) do update set name = excluded.name, status = 'ok', last_seen_at = excluded.last_seen_at, update_time = excluded.update_time where monitor_lark_chat.last_seen_at is null or monitor_lark_chat.last_seen_at <= excluded.last_seen_at
mapper.select:
select c.chat_id, c.name, c.status, coalesce(ref.cnt, 0) as ref_count from monitor_lark_chat c left join (select r.notify_chat_id, count(*) as cnt from monitor_rule r where r.del_flag = '0'
group by r.notify_chat_id) ref on ref.notify_chat_id = c.chat_id where (c.status = 'ok' or ref.cnt > 0)
